title: Map-first Adventure view
summary: Give the lower-screen map an optional compact hero header and remember the chosen view between sessions. Keep contextual route actions and an explicit return to the full deck.
preparation: Install the checksum-verified is.xyz.vcmi.thor candidate. Use a disposable save with a multi-page scenario event, two or more heroes and towns, and access to a Tavern and Mage Guild. Start at default display and font sizing.
limitations: Check physical text readability and touch accuracy on both displays. Map-first applies only to the Adventure map.

checks.title: Map-first layout and persistence
checks.steps: Open the lower Map tab and tap Map first. Check the hero and movement summary, zoom, pan and preview then cancel a route. Open a Town or Hero window from the upper display, close it, and check the map returns. Background and resume, toggle the lower display, and relaunch the game. Select Full deck, check that the Map tab is selected, and confirm that a relaunch uses the full deck again.
checks.expected: Map-first gives the map more room with legible controls. Route actions show only when available. Other windows still display their own lower panels. The Adventure map returns in the chosen view after lifecycle changes and the view switch never moves a hero.

checks.title: Thieves’ Guild return and paging
checks.steps: Open Tavern, switch to Rumor, then open Thieves’ Guild. Page to the last page and back, compare the displayed ties against the upper screen, then tap lower Close. Repeat from the upper Guild button and close on the upper screen.
checks.expected: Both inputs restore Tavern on its prior tab. Pages use one valid page counter, respect their boundaries and agree with the upper screen. Opening a different Tavern starts on Heroes.

checks.title: Kingdom and Hero layouts
checks.steps: From Adventure Actions open Kingdom and switch Heroes and Towns from each screen. Select and open each kind of row, then close it. In Hero, switch Overview, Army and Artifacts; use an empty destination and artifact paging in a disposable save.
checks.expected: The visible tab matches the upper window and remains selected after a child closes. Buttons, lists, help and pagination have separate areas. Overview shows clean primary-stat names and values.

checks.title: Settings order and warnings
checks.steps: Open Settings on the upper screen. Enter each lower category, page its preferences, inspect Interface Scaling and Spellbook animation, and page to Game session. Open Load Game, Main Menu and Restart prompts and decline each. Check Save and Back.
checks.expected: Category choices, preferences and session actions have separate pages. The full heading and page counter stay clear of Haptics. Back has one persistent control. Setting names and their current values are readable. Warning text stays clear of the divider, and decline follows the native parent behavior.

checks.title: Adventure, Town and journal legibility
checks.steps: Review Adventure Actions and Map. Cycle Zoom through Fit, Detail 2× and Detail 4×, pan in Detail, cycle the object filter, switch levels on a two-level map, and hold a marker. Enter Plan, preview and cancel a route, then tap Navigate. Read a multi-page Event, return to List, and close. Check Town Army, Tavern Details and Rumor, and disabled controls in Town Services and Save.
checks.expected: Map view has one toolbar and gains space when there are no available route actions. Preview shows its available actions below the map, and cancelling leaves the hero in place. Tabs, text and rows do not collide. Body text wraps at words where possible and all event text remains accessible. Disabled controls remain inert.

checks.title: Handheld readability and touch targets
checks.steps: Hold the Thor normally and read both screens at default and preferred sizing. Check Map status and legend, Tavern Rumor and Details, and Settings labels and warnings. Tap adjacent Map controls, Hero tabs, Guild paging, Haptics and Back with a thumb, including near their edges.
checks.expected: Text can be read without bringing the device closer. Labels remain clear of adjacent elements. Each deliberate tap activates only its intended control, and disabled controls remain inert.

checks.title: Window and display transitions
checks.steps: Rapidly page and close Guild and Kingdom, background/resume in each, and toggle or reconnect the lower display. Exercise a battle result and verify upper touch/controller navigation and single-display fallback.
checks.expected: Only the current owner and revision receive input. Battle Results page and close through native actions. Reattached display reflects the current upper window, and upper touch/controller behavior stays usable.
